payload.title: The judge sample item keeps adapter evidence as raw {path,line} dicts but judge_fanout._evidence_refs keeps only string entries, so every judge envelope carries a bare file path and a file-head excerpt instead of the cited line
evidence: aria-kernel/aria_kernel/feedback_store.py:1927-1938 (the sample item has fixed keys with no line and passes evidence through as the adapter's list, whose entries are {path,line} dicts)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/judge_fanout.py:207-214 (_evidence_refs appends the path and only entries that are str; a dict entry is dropped)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/judge_fanout.py:115-118 (the rendered prompt block names finding_id, path and message only, no line)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/evidence_excerpts.py:273-278 (a ref with no line is quoted from line 1, the file head within the per-ref cap)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/evidence_excerpts.py:61-62 (the window radius is 40 lines and the per-ref cap 8192 bytes)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/tier0.py:160-168 (the sibling reader of the same sample shape understands {path,line} dicts and builds path:line)
tools/aria-adapters/kernel-dead-wire-adapter.ts:219 (an adapter emits evidence as [{ path, line }])
payload.rule_violated: One owner per concept: the sample item shape has two readers that disagree (tier0._item_refs reads the dict shape, judge_fanout._evidence_refs does not); a judge is asked for file:line evidence about the cited location (judge prompt contract in judge_fanout._render_prompt).
payload.notes: A finding whose evidence is [{path: 'apps/farm-service/src/x.service.ts', line: 120}] is sampled. _evidence_refs returns only 'apps/farm-service/src/x.service.ts', the mint packs the file head (up to 8192 bytes) as the excerpt and the prompt prints no line, so both judges decide true_positive or false_positive on bytes that may not contain the cited code. Verdicts, anchors and promotions then rest on the wrong evidence. The audit reproduced this by execution at 602f2e17d1; the same code stands at d716541239. Close condition: Carry the line and one path:line evidence list in the sample item through the formatter tier0._item_refs already owns, and make judge_fanout._evidence_refs and _render_prompt use it. Close with two tests: _evidence_refs on a sample item built from evidence [{path, line: 120}] contains 'apps/farm-service/src/x.service.ts:120', and the minted envelope's excerpt window is centred on line 120; both are red today. Plan row: none named by the audit (new package: sampler and judge-input contract). Verified at origin/main d716541239.
